item.title: About
item.description:
👋 Hi there

This site focuses on AI for Medicine — advancing computational methods that translate biomedical data into clinically actionable insights.

🔬 Research Focus

  • 🧬 Biomedical data analytics
    Whole-genome sequencing (WGS), bulk and single-cell RNA-seq, variant calling, and functional annotation

  • 🔁 Gene regulatory network modeling
    Integrating multi-omics data to decode regulatory circuits and infer cell-state transitions

  • 🧠 Virtual cell simulation & computational systems biology

    • Virtual cell construction and dynamical simulation
    • In silico gene knockout
    • AI-assisted drug screening and response prediction
    • Cell-fate prediction and pathway optimization

  • 🧪 Translational medicine applications
    Applying computational insights to rare and complex diseases, turning models into actionable clinical strategies

💡 Mission

Bridge cutting-edge AI with real-world medical challenges — building intelligent platforms that deliver explainable, clinically relevant insights.

🛠 Tech & Tools

Languages
Python · R · Shell · C++

Workflow & Environment
Snakemake · Nextflow · Docker · Conda · Git · Slurm

Domains

  • Whole Genome Sequencing (WGS)
  • Transcriptomics (bulk & single-cell RNA-seq)
  • Variant calling and annotation
  • Gene regulatory network inference
  • Multi-omics integration
  • Virtual cell simulation and AI-assisted drug discovery

🎯 Focus Areas

Combining machine learning, deep learning, and biomedical data to explore:

  • Virtual-cell powered disease mechanism studies
  • Computational target discovery and drug screening
  • Intelligent analysis of single-cell multi-omics data
  • Clinical decision-support systems for precision medicine

📧 Let’s connect
Open to collaboration on AI-driven biomedical solutions.

links:

  • title: TCGA description: The Cancer Genome Atlas is a project to catalog genetic mutations responsible for cancer. website: https://portal.gdc.cancer.gov/ image: tcga-logo.png

  • title: NCBI description: National Center for Biotechnology Information provides access to biomedical and genomic information. website: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/ image: ncbi-logo.png

  • title: Ensembl description: Genome browser for vertebrate genomes that supports research in comparative genomics. website: https://www.ensembl.org/ image: ensembl-logo.png

  • title: UCSC Genome Browser description: Interactive genome browser for analyzing genomic data and annotations. website: https://genome.ucsc.edu/ image: ucsc-logo.png

  • title: UniProt description: Comprehensive resource for protein sequence and annotation data. website: https://www.uniprot.org/ image: uniprot-logo.png

  • title: STRING description: Database of known and predicted protein-protein interactions. website: https://string-db.org/ image: string-logo.png

  • title: Gene Ontology description: Structured vocabulary for describing gene and gene product attributes. website: http://geneontology.org/ image: go-logo.png

  • title: KEGG description: Database resource for understanding high-level functions of biological systems. website: https://www.genome.jp/kegg/ image: kegg-logo.png

  • title: ExPASy description: Bioinformatics resource portal providing access to scientific databases and software tools. website: https://www.expasy.org/ image: expasy-logo.png
